notes.title: 2025/08/01Update
notes.notes: [p]No need to start a new save file for this update. If there were any issues with the national team competitions previously, they will be resolved automatically during the next Intercontinental Cup match[/p][p]1. Fix the bug causing confusion in national teams' participation in tournaments[/p][p]2. Fix the bug that displays errors when purchasing residential properties[/p][p]3. Click restrictions have been implemented on the "PLAY" button on match days to prevent bugs caused by players clicking too quickly. It is recommended that players wait for the calculation results on match days and try not to click the "PLAY" button too quickly[/p][p]4. Fix several errors in the broadcast of hot news[/p]
[p]Fix the bug that occurs after arranging the legendary player "Ice Prince" after the update on July 31st[/p]

notes.title: 2025/7/31Update
notes.notes: [p]1. Add a new inheritance module[/p][p]After a player retires and reaches the social status of a superstar and a passing ball king, the player will enter the inheritance system. Superstars will receive two random main attribute+2 abilities, while passing ball kings will receive two random main attribute+3 abilities. When a player creates a new player, they can choose to pass on the ability value bonus to the inheriting player[/p][p]2. Add a locking function for the level and quantity of equipment on the rental housing interface[/p][p]Players can click on the level or quantity of residential facilities to choose to lock. When they click on the dice again, the locked device will not change. After locking, each time the dice is rolled again, it will cost game coins[/p][p]3. Fixed the initial level and facility level for all clubs. Now, every time a new game starts, all clubs no longer randomly generate levels and facilities. Players can customize their clubs by modifying the document[/p][p]4. The club upgrade rules have been adjusted, and now club upgrades require meeting more conditions rather than just judging club facilities[/p][p]5. Adjust the broker investment model. Currently, investment contracts only settle investment returns on a weekly basis and no longer return principal on a weekly basis. The principal will be returned in a lump sum after the contract term is completed[/p][p]6. Temporarily close the AI player transfer for the club, as there are logical errors in AI transfer at this stage, which may lead to financial abnormalities for the club. This change will not affect player transfers. We will create a separate UI interface for club transfers in the next update, which will display transactions between clubs in a more intuitive way to players[/p][p]7. Adjusted some game data, strengthened yellow cards, and highlighted the impact of red cards on the generation of game factual data[/p][p]8. Several bugs have been fixed, which will not be explained here one by one. These bugs caused game crashes in previous versions[/p][p]9. Optimized some of the underlying code and reduced memory usage (this work is still ongoing, and many new features cannot be implemented due to limitations in the current code structure. After this work is completed, more game content will be implemented)[/p][p]Message: Thank you to all players for their support and love towards us. In order to bring a better gaming experience to everyone, we have been working hard. Please rest assured,[/p][p]We are constantly investing all our energy into improving the game. Thank you again and we hope you will continue to support us as always!!![/p]

notes.title: 2025/03/15Update log
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I have made some updates to the game on March 15, 2025. The content of this update is as follows
1. Fixed a bug in some matches where red cards are not banned
2. Fix the bug where canceling interest values will result in the loss of all contracts
3. Fix bugs with duplicate players

notes.title: 2025/03/05 Update log
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I have made some updates to the game on March 5th, 2023. The content of this update is as follows
1. Fixed a bug that caused the broker market to not refresh due to repeated hiring and firing of economic agents
2. Fixed a bug that caused problems with the team lineup due to the signing of our own players
3. Fixed a bug where the emotional state cannot be correctly restored when the residential area is bustling
4. Optimized the response speed of the Play button

notes.title: 2025/03/01 update log
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. I made some updates to the game on March 1, 2025. The content of this update is as follows
1. Updated a simple help module to help new friends understand our game faster
2. Adjusted the calculation method of player value, and now the player value is closer to the real world
3. The bug caused by dynamic transfer has been fixed. This bug will cause the weekly settlement and season settlement to not be carried out normally, so that the leaderboard data will not be updated every season. Now we have fixed this problem
4. Fixed that the liquidated damages for endorsements and investments signed by commercial brokers when players choose to terminate the contract will not be correctly displayed in the weekly settlement
5. We have adjusted the archive structure. Before the adjustment, players often crash the game when archiving, resulting in bad files. We have redefined the archive data structure to bring better experience to players
This update requires players to re open the file, so please forgive me for the inconvenience caused to players

notes.title: Welcome to our big family, QQ group 741412001
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the first time we meet, Xiao Wu is here to send you the most sincere wishes!
Thank you for your support and welcome to our QQ group (741412001) to chat with us about games, football, life and life. If you have any comments or suggestions on our game, you are welcome to tell us at any time.
We promise you that the game will be continuously updated until all our ideas are completed. We will try our best to build a perfect football world for you and let you create your own wonderful life.

Xiao Wu thanks you again for your support, handshake and salute!

notes.title: The Chinese version of the game is officially launched
notes.notes:
Dear Players

At this thrilling moment, we are overjoyed to announce to you all – after countless days and nights of meticulous crafting and unwavering efforts, our game "Pro Football Career" has officially launched today! 🌟🎉

From the initial spark of creativity to its dazzling debut today, every step has been filled with the blood, sweat, and tears of our development team. However, on this journey filled with challenges and exploration, we were not alone. It was because of you – every game-loving friend who has given us unwavering support and encouragement – that this journey has become truly meaningful. Here, we sincerely extend our deepest gratitude to every supporter! 🙏💖

Thank you for your patient waiting. Even during the longest period of the game's redesign, when we went six months without releasing any updates, you never abandoned us. Your valuable feedback guided us in the right direction. Thank you for every share, like, and comment on social media; it was this collective light that illuminated the path for "Pro Football Career." 💡❤️

Today, as we jointly unveil the mystery of "Pro Football Career," we hope this game will bring you an unprecedented football gaming experience. Whether it's the intense competition on the green field or the meticulous planning of a player's career, we want you to feel the charm and passion of football, making it a part of your cherished memories. ⚽️💪

We promise that the launch is just the beginning. In the future, we will continue to update content, optimize the experience, and bring more surprises and challenges, ensuring that the world of "Pro Football Career" becomes increasingly rich and worthy of every player's expectations. 🚀

Thank you once again to all the players for your support and love. Let's embark together into this virtual world of football and start our legendary journey!

– Sincerely, Xiao Wu Studio
